Current non-M5 head on INITIAL representation gives meanPUP0.514-0.535; INITIAL head on FINAL representation still gives0.735-0.773. An output-head-only correction is not supported as a sufficient explanation of the observed endpoint drift.

The3factor December F/non-M5 accounting assigns mean logit contributions0.787-0.845 to changed upstream hidden,0.347-0.470 to query projection and0.070-0.085 to side head in the symmetric allocation. All6 ordered paths and all8 endpoint combinations remain visible.

State/S differs: in December non-M5, upstream hidden contribution is0.036-0.053 while query projection is0.239-0.312. Do not conflate S with endpoint-displacement F or transfer a single explanation across tasks.
For December M5F, symmetric hidden/query/head contributions are0.141669/0.040416/0.078429 logit. Its dedicated head matters more proportionally than the common non-M5 head.
The evidence localizes changed prediction behavior in the learned mapping before the final heads; it does not establish why that mapping was learned or repair its later directional ranking.
